scope: exploratory within-known-applications grouped whole-trial folds; P5 required for independent validation
normalization: each session divided by its own recorded rest baseline before pooling

augmentation.gain: per-trial channel factor log-uniform [1/1.5, 1.5] and global factor [1/1.25, 1.25], resampled each epoch
augmentation.gain_dropout: gain plus one post-preprocessing channel zeroed in 15% of trials each epoch
